messages:
cs-rep-amy: Acme reported 503s from /v1/generate starting ~11:40 UTC, multiple users affected. example request_id=acme-req-91. p95 spiked before failures.
support: Investigating root cause — logs show upstream worker exits and 503s returned by gateway. Tagging eng oncall.
julian (oncall): @channel I'm on it. Any correlation with last model rollout or infra changes?
micah (eng-runtime): There was a canary hotswap of quant-llama-v2@v3 at 11:38. I'm seeing nvml device reset events on node gpu-n12 right after.
micah (eng-runtime): Quick log extract:
```
[11:39:18] infer_runner: upstream exit signal SIGABRT (code 6)
nvml: device 0 reset detected
kernel: GPU reset by peer, reason=DRIVER_RESTART
```
k8s-bot: pod infer-gpu-n12-66dc restarted (OOMKilled) — restartCount: 3
sara (eng-sre): Can we confirm whether this is limited to quantized binary or affects baseline weights too?
micah (eng-runtime): Preliminary repro shows quant path triggers heavy attention kernel with KV prefetch thrash; baseline appears stable. I can repro locally with a stress harness.
micah (eng-runtime): Repro command I used:
```
python stress_client.py --model quant-llama-v2 --context 32 --concurrency 24 --prefetch=true
```
Observed memory balloon -> nvml reset -> runner exit.
julian (oncall): Mitigation: shift traffic off the canary to the non-quant fallback and cordon node gpu-n12. @deploy-bot start rollback.
deploy-bot: rollback request accepted — decreasing canary traffic for quant-llama-v2@v3 15% -> 0% across hosted pool (in progress)
sara (eng-sre): Evicting pods on gpu-n12 and widening KV prefetch backoff to avoid thundering herd during recovery.
micah (eng-runtime): Plan for hotfix: add soft memory cap around quantized attention kernel and fallback to reference kernel on breach. Will open hotfix branch and test against isolated pool.
support: CS updated Acme: traffic shifted to fallback model, investigating root cause and working on fix. Customer asked about credits — tagging finance.
finance: We'll review impact window and advise credits after incident review. Capture minutes of degraded p95 and error rate.
julian (oncall): Next steps: capture heap + nvml dumps from gpu-n12 (already queued), validate hotfix on isolated canary, and check driver/kernel versions across cloud images. Update playbook with hotswap guardrails.
micah (eng-runtime): Uploaded heap diffs and NVML logs to internal storage: https://internal/redwood/incident/8290001111 (contains nvml.log, heap-diff.tar.gz).
cs-rep-amy: Acme confirms service restored post-rollback and will monitor. Thanks for the fast action :thumbsup:
julian (oncall): Marking as active incident until patch validated and can close with postmortem. Will start timeline and assignment for writeup.
